title: Prussian blue regulates ion dynamics in perovskite solar cells
title_zh: 普鲁士蓝调控钙钛矿太阳能电池中的离子动力学
abstract: Perovskite photovoltaics are limited by structural instabilities initiated during crystallization and amplified under operation. We report that a lattice-matched Prussian blue scaffold directs heterogeneous nucleation to produce highly oriented, strain-relaxed films. Its redox-active Fe–C≡N–Fe network mediates the conversion of Pb 0 and I 0 defects, and its rigid open framework suppresses A-site cation redistribution and the resulting electronic inhomogeneity under bias. This strategy yielded champion power conversion efficiencies of 26.1% (n-i-p) and 26.9% (p-i-n; 26.2% certified), scaling to 23.4% in 6-centimeter–by–6-centimeter minimodules and a certified 22.9% in 30-centimeter–by–30-centimeter submodules. Submodules with initial power conversion efficiencies ranging from 20.2 to 21.0% showed robust durability under accelerated aging and no discernible decline relative to a silicon reference over 5 months of outdoor testing.
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿光伏器件受晶化过程中引发的结构不稳定性限制，并在工作中被放大。我们报告了一种晶格匹配的普鲁士蓝支架，它通过异质成核产生高度取向、应变缓解的薄膜。其可氧化还原的 Fe–C≡N–Fe 网络介导 Pb⁰ 与 I⁰ 缺陷的转化，而其刚性开放框架抑制了 A 位阳离子重分布及随之产生的电荷不均匀性。该策略实现了 26.1%（n-i-p）和 26.9%（p-i-n；26.2% 认证）的冠军光电转换效率，在 6 cm×6 cm 的 mini 模块中可扩展至 23.4%，在 30 cm×30 cm 的子模块中获得 22.9% 的认证效率。初始光电转换效率在 20.2%–21.0% 之间的子模块在加速老化测试中表现出强健的耐久性，并在 5 个月的户外测试中相较于硅参考器件未出现可辨别的性能下降。
